title: Matched-computation calibration of a learned geometry hierarchy
scope: Constructed independent-episode mechanism experiment. Fresh tuned native KAHM fits. No natural-data or universal KAHM superiority claim.

data_law.history: X_j=S_j*(0.9+U_j), independent equiprobable signs and U_j uniform[-0.1,0.1]
data_law.irreducible: Y=0.8*V_1*V_2+E; V is an independent hidden draw from the history law
data_law.noise: E uniform[-0.05,0.05], independent of every history
data_law.draw_order: X signs then jitters; irreducible hidden V signs then jitters; target noise
data_law.law_status: Same published mechanism as existing learned-KAHM decision study; new sampling pools and geometry fits

loss: ordinary scalar squared prediction error; predictions clipped to declared target bounds; no loss capping
tolerance_rationale: Inherited published mechanism-study tolerance and decoder budget; retained before new data, not selected for certificate success.

geometry_menu.native_dimension_default: min(20,input_dimension,local_reference_count-1); cap2 is the ambient-default baseline here, cap1 is the smaller alternative
geometry_menu.geometry_fit: support inputs only; shared partition references across local caps; no held-out clipping

head.family: scalar BlockBoundedRidge; free intercept; sum of retained block Euclidean coefficient norms <=2
head.metric: maximum Euclidean distance across retained soft blocks
head.guard: Radially shrink only if norm sum exceeds2-1e-12; recompute optimal training-mean intercept and objective/gap
head.nonconvergence: Retain the finite feasible candidate with its recorded gap; no row exclusion

selection.common_geometry: Minimum largest-prefix validation MSE across all16 geometries and3 ridges; tie by geometry index then ridge index
selection.geometry_order: MinMax01 then standard; cap1 then2; concentration0.5,4,16,64
selection.each_prefix_head: Minimum validation MSE across the3 ridge candidates for the chosen common geometry; first ridge index breaks ties
selection.nesting: Every selected prefix retains identical earlier soft blocks, scaling, local cap and concentration. Zero extension preserves the decoder budget.

block_partition: Consecutive disjoint complete blocks in original episode order; eachmaximal4096 draw reused by leading prefixes

certificate_methods.hierarchy: Maximum of five individually KL-calibrated centered block SSE/(b-1) endpoints using n/b independent blocks and the sharp scalar score range
certificate_methods.recycled: The identical signed-dual SSE values summed/n lower-bound one full-sample empirical Lipschitz infimum; maximize these values over five partitions and use one empirical-minimum KL event at sample size n and loss range1.7^2
certificate_methods.combined: Maximum of the already jointly covered hierarchy and recycled endpoints, with no additional optimization or confidence event
certificate_methods.upper: Common one-sided bounded-loss KL upper endpoint for the fixed fitted model
certificate_methods.upper_only: Cheapest fitted class passing U<=0.1; cannot exclude any entire class

event_count: 24 learning cases *2 retained classes *3 sample prefixes *(5 block lower +1 recycled empirical-minimum lower +1 fitted upper)
confidence_scope: Joint over every listed class, case, sample prefix, and endpoint, conditional on all construction and selection data
allocation_note: Equal per-endpoint alpha; the five-member block family receives five times the aggregate failure budget of the one recycled endpoint. Per-b recycled endpoints and their maximum are covered by the same empirical-infimum event.

solver.algorithm: unchanged signed-edge proximal FISTA; all signed multipliers retained
solver.unconverged: Retain feasible dual lower value and actual gap; no solver-based sample rejection
solver.arithmetic_failure: Abort study stage explicitly; no replacement stream or silent numerical fallback

primary_endpoint.repairable: L_prefix2>0.1 and common U_prefix6<=0.1: refinement resolved
primary_endpoint.irreducible: Both retained classes have lower endpoints>0.1: joint class exclusion
primary_endpoint.comparison: At n1024, count paired both/hierarchy-only/recycled-only/neither outcomes over12 independent complete learning runs per regime
primary_endpoint.inference: Descriptive paired procedure counts; no population superiority test over training data
primary_endpoint.secondary: All endpoints and decisions at n256 and4096, combined endpoints, and terminal forecast quality

cost.primary_order: Retained prefixes2 then6; actual retained numerical payload is recorded and must increase in that order
cost.fit: Charge full geometry construction, unused regrouped banks, all feature encoding,96 candidate head fits and validation
cost.certificate: Shared block-dual solve time plus separate hierarchy/recycled/upper postprocessing; no new QP for recycled calibration
cost.deployment: Separate uncached1024-row forward queries for each retained prefix, encoder and head times, numerical payload and pickle bytes
cost.not_claimed: Fit-skipping savings, equality of simplex dimension and runtime, or end-to-end interval assurance

known_risk_scope: Irreducible constant zero belongs to every declared class and attains known target variance; repairable noise variance is a Bayes floor, not an asserted learned-class optimum. Terminal conditional risks average over fresh sampled X, not exact integrated fitted population risks.

stream_ledger.prior_exclusion: All explicit inherited Step10 reservations and Steps11-16 scientific/manufactured streams; no overlap

reporting: Every candidate, selected configuration, confidence endpoint, unresolved decision, optimization gap and runtime retained. No new data until freeze and preflight gates. No source or protocol changes after freeze.
